text: Bitcoin is outpacing Ethereum's gains today, with BTC up 1.1% versus ETH's 0.4%, suggesting selective strength in the larger asset while altcoins like SOL show relative resilience. Fear & Greed sits at 59 (Greed) but has retreated 10 points over the week, indicating sentiment peaked recently and some caution is creeping back in despite current price stability. BTC dominance holding above 60% combined with $44.8B in daily volume reflects a healthy, balanced market without panic or euphoria-driven extremes.
